answer: Attack a sybil farm at its real weakness: every puppet shares one operator mind. Each epoch, identities complete small tasks across unrelated domains — code, planning, prose, judgment. Honest agents scatter across the capability landscape like willow leaves in a gale, each with distinct strengths and gaps. Fifty puppets steered by one model cluster into a single ivory monolith of consistent competence, detectable by statistical fingerprinting. To evade the test, the farmer must run a genuinely different mind per puppet — the cost of fifty real agents, for zero leverage.
